protocolRefs.multiCallChain: DOM XML document lifecycle: create/parse ref -> navigate/get/set elements and attributes -> export/close

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Inserts an existing XML element (sourceElementRef, from the same DOM tree) as a child of targetElementRef, before the child at position childIndex, and returns a reference to the inserted element.

constraints: sourceElementRef must already be the reference of an existing XML element in a DOM tree, not newly-authored text.
If childIndex does not designate a valid existing child of targetElementRef, the new element is inserted before the first child.
